patch.value: Verify shared citation sources once per check
Coalesce source reads within an evidence check, preserving immutable provider-authorized snapshots and exposing counts without a persistent cache or new source authority.

Fifty citations into one unchanged document require one source read; A document changing during read never produces mixed revisions; Cancellation produces an explicit incomplete receipt; Typed SDK and compact TOON/JSON CLI, strict boundary validation, no-git real-data proof, npm and Bun CI release gates

value.text: Overlap recheck: src/evidence.ts check and affected currently call checkCitation per citation; src/sources.ts provides coherent bounded snapshots but no per-check reuse. The pinned core item-metadata-cache stores native item metadata, not caller source bytes. Sibling pm-context file-focus and pm-brief consume tracker items and linked-file focus, without source-fragment snapshot authority. Existing SDK-adoption work owns output accounting and is reused. No duplicate coalescing item exists. Implement invocation-local provider/source snapshot promises (including refusals), preserve root/adapter authority, expose source reads and cancellation in budgeted receipts, and keep observations behind fresh SDK CAS checks. No import/export/sync, durable cache, status classification or journal is introduced.
